runtime: ECMAScript engine built-ins and the Node.js runtime (lib.*.d.ts / @types/node symbols; also TypeScript and TSX)
conventions: Symbols are the declaration names of the TypeScript lib files: interface members (Function.bind, JSON.stringify), constructor interfaces (ObjectConstructor.defineProperty) and Node modules (util.promisify). Node's own lib/ is compiled into the node binary, so it is not readable source.

entries.describe: f.bind(thisArg, ...args) returns a wrapper that calls f
entries.why: engine built-in; the function is the receiver, not a typed parameter
engine built-in; the function is the receiver, not a typed parameter

entries.describe: defineProperty(o, key, {get, set}) runs get on every read and set on every write of the property
entries.why: engine built-in; the descriptor type says the getter may run, not that it runs on property access

entries.describe: Object.assign(target, ...sources) copies every own enumerable member of each source onto target (and returns target)
entries.why: engine built-in (compiled into the engine, no readable source); the declared type T & U describes the result's type, not that the members are copied onto the target object at run time

entries.describe: Object.create(proto) returns a new object whose member lookups fall back to proto (its prototype)
entries.why: engine built-in (compiled into the engine, no readable source); the declared type is any, so prototype delegation is not visible in any type

entries.describe: Object.setPrototypeOf(o, proto) makes member lookups on o that find nothing fall back to proto (and returns o)
entries.why: engine built-in (compiled into the engine, no readable source); the declared types (any / object) do not express prototype delegation

entries.describe: Reflect.setPrototypeOf(o, proto) makes member lookups on o that find nothing fall back to proto (returns a boolean)
entries.why: engine built-in (compiled into the engine, no readable source); the declared types (any / object) do not express prototype delegation

entries.describe: JSON.stringify(value) calls value.toJSON() when it exists
entries.why: engine built-in: the toJSON protocol is not in the parameter type (any)
ToString conversion is defined by the language specification, not by a parameter type

entries.describe: new Promise(executor) calls the executor synchronously, before the constructor returns
entries.why: engine built-in; the executor's type does not say that it runs immediately

entries.describe: Array.from(iterable, mapFn) iterates the iterable and calls mapFn on every item
entries.why: engine built-in: the iteration protocol is not in the parameter type

entries.describe: promisify/callbackify(fn) return a wrapper that calls fn
entries.why: Node's lib/ is compiled into the node binary (no readable source); the type does not say that the result calls fn

entries.describe: deprecate(fn, message) returns a wrapper that warns and calls fn
entries.why: Node's lib/ is compiled into the node binary (no readable source)

entries.describe: emitter.on(event, listener) stores the listener; emit(event) calls it later
entries.why: Node's lib/ is compiled into the node binary; the listener type does not say it runs later on emit

io_send.describe: fetch(url, {method}) sends an HTTP request (browser / Node / Deno / Bun built-in)
http.request(url | options, [options], cb) sends an HTTP request (Node lib compiled into the binary)
https.request(url | options, ...) sends an HTTPS request (Node lib compiled into the binary)
http.get(url | options, cb) sends a GET request
https.get(url | options, cb) sends a GET request
xhr.open(method, url) prepares a browser HTTP request
new WebSocket(url) opens a message channel to url
new EventSource(url) subscribes to server-sent events at url
navigator.sendBeacon(url, data) sends a POST request
net.connect(port | path | options) opens a raw socket
net.createConnection(port | path | options) opens a raw socket
exec(command line) runs a shell command line
execSync(command line) runs a shell command line
fork(modulePath, args) runs a Node script in a child process

io_entry.describe: http.createServer([options], listener): the runtime calls listener(request, response) for every request; request.url is the route key, request.method the verb
https.createServer(options, listener): the runtime calls listener(request, response) for every request
http2.createServer([options], listener): the runtime calls listener for every request
server.on('request', listener): the runtime emits 'request' for every HTTP request
net.createServer([options], listener): the runtime calls listener(socket) for every connection
Deno.serve([options], handler): the runtime calls handler(request) for every request
Bun.serve({fetch}): the runtime calls fetch(request) for every request
module worker convention (WinterCG runtimes): the runtime calls the default export's fetch(request) for every request

reflection_roots.describe: decorator metadata stored under a key and read back by a framework's scanner (Reflect.getMetadata); decorators built on it are derived

fs_routes.describe: Next.js pages router: the default export of pages/api/<path> handles /api/<path> ([id] segments are placeholders)
Next.js app router: exported GET/POST/... functions of app/<path>/route handle /<path>
Remix: the exported loader of app/routes/<route> handles GET requests of the route
Remix: the exported action of app/routes/<route> handles non-GET requests of the route
SvelteKit: exported GET/POST/... functions of src/routes/<path>/+server handle /<path>
Nuxt/Nitro: the default export of server/api/<path> handles /api/<path> (a .get/.post suffix restricts the verb)
Nuxt/Nitro: the default export of server/routes/<path> handles /<path>
Astro endpoints: exported GET/POST/... functions of src/pages/<path>.ts handle /<path>

ffi_conventions.describe: loads a native addon (require of a .node file derives down to it); the addon registers its functions through N-API
instantiates a wasm module; instance.exports.<name> calls the module's export <name>
instantiates a wasm module from a response; exports are called by name
new WebAssembly.Instance(module, imports): exports are called by name, imports are called by the module

test_conventions.describe: Imported TAP API enables syntax test-block candidates independent of file paths; execution is not assumed
Jest default testMatch when no Jest configuration sets it
Vitest default include when no Vitest configuration sets it
Mocha default spec directory ./test when no .mocharc sets spec
node --test default patterns (*.test.js, *-test.js, *_test.js; also test-*.js and test/**)

syntax_conventions.describe: the client class generated from a .proto (or loaded by @grpc/proto-loader) is <Service>Client or <Service>, constructed with an address and channel credentials
a client constructor whose second argument is built from grpc.credentials is a generated gRPC client
grpc.credentials.createInsecure() as the second constructor argument marks a generated gRPC client
grpc.credentials.createSsl() as the second constructor argument marks a generated gRPC client
ChannelCredentials as the second constructor argument marks a generated gRPC client
server.addService(Service.service, {rpc: handler}) binds each handler to the rpc named by its key
gql`...` holds a GraphQL document; its top-level fields are the operations the client sends
graphql`...` holds a GraphQL document; its top-level fields are the operations the client sends
a resolver map {Query: {field: resolver}} binds each function to the root field named by its key (read by the GraphQL executor at run time)
require('bindings')('name') loads the compiled addon name.node found in the build output directories
require('node-gyp-build')(dir) loads the compiled addon found in the build / prebuilds directories
